description: 通信模块重置粒度与陌生主体恢复
research_question: 在给定 resident 端点协议和共同任务回报后，只有发送端、只有接收端或发送与接收两端都失去通信参数，哪一侧的非语言能力足以恢复共同符号的功能？

factorial.resident_cultures: static/random role order × fixed A, rotating A/B, random A/B/C formation

social_learning.newcomer: identity 0 copied from the resident endpoint; selected communication modules reset with a shared seed
social_learning.trainable: only the reset sender group, receiver group, or both groups
social_learning.residents: communication and private visual modules frozen
social_learning.role_mode: same role mode as resident culture

controls: v0.46 full communication reset under random A/B/C adaptation
measures.interpretation: Reset-mode effects isolate communication-side recovery only when visual group, resident culture, reset seed and adaptation schedule are held fixed; all results remain finite-protocol evidence.

hypotheses: Receiver-only reset may recover faster than sender-only reset because resident senders already provide a stable symbol stream.
Full reset should have the largest early deficit and should approach, but not necessarily reach, one-sided recovery.
Random-role resident cultures should reduce role spread for every reset mode, while endpoint function may depend more strongly on which communication side is reset.
controls_and_limits: Reset modes are fully crossed with six resident cultures; adaptation schedule, visual groups and update budgets are fixed.
The newcomer inherits the resident visual frontend and all unreset communication modules; new perception is deferred.
The task remains the finite six-site, three-resource, two-token grounded protocol inherited from v0.43.
Resident agents are frozen during adaptation; there is no negotiation, repair, delayed resource inventory or generation turnover.
